forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Decide how LibGit2Transport gets an SSH transport, because swift-libgit2 1.9.7 builds none
+---
+## What
+
+Card `^vf3a6an` found the cause of the SSH failure. `swift-libgit2` 1.9.7 builds libgit2 with no SSH transport on macOS. `git_libgit2_features()` has the `GIT_FEATURE_SSH` bit at `0`, and `git_remote_connect` on an SSH URL gives `unsupported URL protocol` before it starts a process.
+
+The manifest of the package has this line:
+
+```swift
+.define("GIT_SSH_EXEC", to: "1", .when(platforms: [.android, .linux, .macOS], traits: []))
+```
+
+SwiftPM never satisfies a condition that has an empty trait list. The result is the same with the `swiftbuild` build system and with the `native` build system. Tags 1.9.4, 1.9.6, 1.9.7 and the upstream default branch all have the same line.
+
+## The decision that a person must make
+
+`marketplace.md` decision 10 and the doc comment of `LibGit2Transport` say that SSH uses the libgit2 exec transport and the system OpenSSH. This package cannot set a C define on a target of a dependency. These are the known paths:
+
+1. Send a correction to `danielctull-forks/swift-libgit2` (remove `traits: []` from the two `GIT_SSH` lines, or add a trait for the exec transport), and then move the pin.
+2. Use a fork of `swift-libgit2` that has the correction.
+3. Enable the `libssh2` trait. This adds the `swift-libssh2` dependency, and it needs an SSH credential callback (the SSH agent) in `LibGit2Transport`. This changes decision 10.
+
+## The work after the decision
+
+- Make an SSH URL fetch a commit through the real `LibGit2Transport`.
+- Add the integration test that card `^vf3a6an` asks for (see the blocker on that card for the question of where that test lives).
+- Until SSH works, `docs/marketplaces.md` gives the SSH form as its first example, and the family manifests use SSH URLs. Correct the document, or make SSH work.
+
+#marketplace
\ No newline at end of file
